No, that is not true. The 13th AHV pension (also known as the "13. AHV-Rente") is not limited to people with an invalidity pension. It is a one-time payment made to all individuals who receive an old-age pension (AHV-Altersrente) or an invalidity pension (IV-Rente) in Switzerland.

Key points:
- It is an additional, one-time payment.
- It is automatically paid to all eligible pension recipients without the need for a separate application.
- The amount and eligibility criteria are determined by the federal government and are not dependent on a separate application process by the individual.

So, you do not need to apply for it separately if you are already receiving an old-age or invalidity pension.
